nodes_update.name: Lahiri Mahasaya
nodes_update.note: Shyama Charan Lahiri, b. 30 Sept 1828 Ghurni, Nadia; d. 26 Sept 1895 Benares. Clerk/accountant, Military Engineering Department 1851-1886; Kriya Yoga for householders from 1861
Known only through the accounts of Lahiri Mahasaya, his disciples and Yogananda; met Lahiri near Ranikhet in 1861 by Lahiri's account

edges_upsert.note: Lahiri's account as reported by disciples and by Yogananda (Autobiography of a Yogi, ch. 34, 1946); no evidence outside the lineage
Met Lahiri in 1884 (Wikipedia, Yukteswar) and was initiated into Kriya Yoga; visited Lahiri often in Benares
Required to give up sannyasa and return to household life before initiation; later authorised to found the Arya Mission Institution, Calcutta (c. 1885/1886)
Initiated by Lahiri; reported meeting Babaji near Badrinath (Yogananda)
Initiated Yogananda's parents; blessed the infant ('Little mother, thy son will be a yogi', per YSS). Died 1895 when Yogananda was under three; training came through Yukteswar
Kriya's components (khechari mudra, mahamudra, yoni mudra, pranayama, spinal chakras) are named in earlier hatha texts

glossary.def: In Lahiri Mahasaya's line, a set of breathing and concentration techniques, moving breath and attention along the spine, given by initiation in graded stages. Patanjali uses the same name for a discipline of austerity, study and devotion.
A hatha yoga practice in which the tongue is turned back and up behind the soft palate; part of Kriya Yoga in Lahiri's line.
Literally 'unchanging'; in Kriya Yoga, the point between the eyebrows where attention rests and the still awareness experienced there.
A householder: someone living with a family and an occupation, as opposed to a renunciant monk.

lahiri-mahasaya: Born 30 Sept 1828, Ghurni, Nadia; parents Gaur Mohan and Muktakeshi; married Kashimoni 1846; clerk from 1851; died 26 Sept 1895 Benares -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lahiri_Mahasaya

Ghurni on the Jalangi near Krishnanagar; mother died 1833; children Tinkori, Dukori, Harimoti, Harikamini, Harimohini; Military Engineering Department 1851; postings Gazipur, Mirzapur, Naini Tal, Danapur, Benares; retired 1886; commentaries on 26 scriptures -> https://www.srichinmoylibrary.com/lm-21e1

Accountant, Military Engineering Department, Danapur; transfer to Ranikhet ~500 miles, ~30 days; Drongiri; recall letter 'occurred by error'; quotes 'in the crowded marts, serving as an example of the ideal yogi-householder' and 'Give Kriya freely to all who humbly ask for help'; Moradabad episode -> https://anandaindia.org/autobiography-of-a-yogi/materializing-a-palace-in-the-himalaya/

Quotes 'Solve all your problems through meditation', 'Exchange unprofitable religious speculations for actual God-contact', 'Let the fragrance of the Kriya flower be wafted naturally, without any display'; Abdul Gufoor Khan; Hindus, Muslims, Christians; retired on pension 1886; little parlor, lotus posture; Gita Assembly; 26 scriptures; four graded Kriyas; rejected title Kashi Baba; Arya Mission permitted -> https://hinduwebsite.com/sacredscripts/spiritualism/yogananda/yogananda_35.asp
'Banat banat ban jai' = 'Striving, striving, one day behold! The Divine Goal!', AoY ch. 27, recalled by Pranabananda -> https://www.ananda.org/ask/phrase-banat-banatban-jai-autobiography-yogi/

Photograph story, Ganga Dhar Babu, twelve plates, 'I am Spirit. Can your camera reflect the omnipresent Invisible?', AoY ch. 1 -> https://www.ananda.org/blog/lahiri-mahasayas-enigmatic-photograph/ and https://gutenberg.org/cache/epub/7452/pg7452-images.html
'Little mother, thy son will be a yogi'; no organisation in his lifetime; 'About fifty years after my passing, an account of my life will be written' -> https://yssofindia.org/about/lahiri-mahasaya
Died on Mahashtami; worked in public works department of military engineering; quotes on Vishwanath -> https://kriya.org/guru/shri-lahiri-mahashaya/en
Panchanan Bhattacharya 1853-1919; required to leave sannyasa; Arya Mission c.1885/1886; cheap Gita editions, herbal medicines -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Panchanan_Bhattacharya
Yukteswar initiated by Lahiri 1884; met Babaji Kumbh Mela Allahabad 1894 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swami_Sri_Yukteswar_Giri

Babaji witnesses (Yukteswar, Pranabananda, Keshabananda near Badrinath); ~500 years per Pranabananda; Kriya Babaji Sangah founded 17 Oct 1952 by Neelakantan and Ramaiah -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mahavatar_Babaji
Four parts of Kriya, thokar; White on Yogananda's use of the name; lineages; Gita 4.29 reading -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kriya_Yoga_school
Mahamudra, khechari mudra, yoni mudra, pranayama, thokar, higher Kriyas extensions of second -> https://www.yoganiketan.net/aboutus?id=262

Purana Purusha, Ashoke Kumar Chatterjee, French 1997, English 2000; Satya Charan Lahiri furnished details -> https://www.vedicbooks.net/purana-purusha-yogiraj-shama-churn-lahiree-complete-biography-p-14429.html
26 diaries held by grandson Satya Charan Lahiri, entrusted to Chatterjee -> https://digitalpublisher999.itch.io/lahirimahasayalectures
Keshavananda initiated by Lahiri; Katyayani Peeth, Vrindavan -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Keshavananda_Brahmachari
Shibendu Lahiri great-grandson, family lineage of Kriya -> https://data.bnf.fr/15545226/shibendu_lahiri/fr.pdf

Still unverified from the text: Trailanga Swami's admiration for Lahiri (ch. 31; Wikipedia 'Trailanga' confirms he appears in ch. 31), and posthumous appearances to disciples. The 'fifty years after my passing' prediction is confirmed by YSS as Lahiri's words relayed by Yukteswar to Yogananda, but its chapter in AoY was not confirmed.
